policy: Three UUID-selected calibration scans per material/treatment with at least four printings. Rendered cards, art and lettering cannot enter pose fitting. Disjoint strips select additional rotation/skew, then a third set can only reject. Sparse land and split cards are explicitly outside this certification. No per-card pose enters renderer defaults.
